snippet.title: Reapercussions - Multiplayer Mode reveal for a new Balatro-like indie strategy game!
snippet.description:
Reapercussions is an upcoming indie strategy game where you play as a Reaper collecting souls for Purgatory using the fabled death dice. Here's a breakdown of the upcoming game's features. 

This is the upcoming Versus multiplayer mode! 

Coming early 2027

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5383750/Reapercussions/

Check out illi.gg for more info. 

#Reapercussions #balatro #IndieGame #GodotEngine #SteamNextFest
